Name: Ankur Nahar
Bio:
Prof Ankur Nahar is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha University and Group Lead of Anvay Lab. He earned his PhD from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Jodhpur, mentored by Prof Debasis Das of IIT Jodhpur and Prof Sajal K. Das of Missouri University of Science and Technology, USA.

His professional experience includes teaching as an Assistant Professor and working as a Network Engineer, contributing to student development, academic programs, and network management. He has engaged in international collaborations through academic visits to the University of Melbourne, Tashkent University of Information Technologies, and IIT Kharagpur. He has also presented his work at international symposiums.
Research_Summary:
Prof Nahar's research focuses on scalable, secure, and intelligent network architectures for heterogeneous and real-time applications. His current thrust is to develop adaptive, programmable, and self-healing networks through intelligent control, resource allocation, congestion avoidance, and low-latency delivery.

Software-Defined Networking and Internet routing (BGP)

5G/6G core networks

Vehicular ad hoc networks, vehicular cloud computing, and intelligent transportation systems

Edge and fog computing

Network intelligence and adaptive resource management
Research_Interests: Vehicular ad-hoc networks | Congestion control in multipath TCP | Fifth-generation cellular networks | Routing optimization | Routing and Switching | Computer Networks | Cloud Computing
